items.title: The Gysin pullback of the divisor of a meromorphic section is the first Chern class of its restriction capped with the fundamental class of the divisor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an effective Cartier divisor D in an integral X of delta-dimension n and a nonzero meromorphic section t of an invertible module N, the Gysin pullback i^* div_N(t) equals c_1(N|_D) cap [D]_{n-1} in CH_{n-2}(D) (statement lines 5351-5361, tag 02TM). The proof must choose compatible local generators at the generic points of the components of the divisor, with the extra requirement that the generator of O_X(D) be the canonical section away from D, express both cycles through those generators, and then invoke the key formula to turn the difference into a sum of divisors of tame symbols which vanishes away from D. The bookkeeping of the two coefficient expressions is the substance, so the claim is H2.
